# testdata/recovery/metadata

Committed goldens for the `harmony-recovery metadata` command family.

- `golden/root-help.txt`, `golden/metadata-help.txt`, `golden/preflight-help.txt`
  — CLI help goldens pinned by `cmd/harmony-recovery.TestGoldenHelpFiles`
  (regenerate with `UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./cmd/harmony-recovery/`). The
  preflight golden pins that registration of the metadata group left the
  preflight help byte-identical.
- `kit/` — the committed localnet fixture kit, regenerated byte-identically
  by `scripts/recovery/gen-metadata-fixtures.sh` (canonicalized LevelDB
  directories, deterministic block times, fixture-only BLS secrets derived
  from fixed scalars, dev committee keys from the public `.hmy` keys):
  - `kit/harmony_db_0/` — the dirty chain: head 48, target 30 (epoch 2),
    pre-target create-validator (22) / delegate (26) / precompile-actor
    funding (28), the 36/37 epoch transition, and the post-target
    abandoned-branch staking schedule — create (40), delegate (42), top-up
    (43), plus the `0xfc` precompile delegation matrix: direct (45), nested
    contract→`0xfc` (46), reverted (47), top-up (48).
  - `kit/clean/harmony_db_0/` — the clean twin: the same deterministic
    chain ended at the target (blocks 1..30 byte-identical to the dirty
    chain's).
  - `kit/fixture-keys/` — fixture-only BLS secrets (public test keys, never
    used outside tests).
  - `kit/recovery-anchor.localnet.json` — the kit's anchor config.
  - `kit/reference/` — golden export artifacts over the dirty DB
    (`metadata-30.hmr`, `metadata-30.reference.json`,
    `run-checksums.sha256`). The internal export report (run evidence:
    absolute paths, inode, timestamps) is deliberately excluded — it is
    machine-specific by design.
  - `kit/ground-truth.json` — target tuple, staking schedule and artifact
    digests.

  `acceptance.TestCommittedKitGolden` pins a fresh in-process export over
  the committed dirty DB against these goldens byte-for-byte. The
  acceptance suite otherwise generates fixtures in-process; the committed
  kit is the pinned golden, the devops-pilot input (§5.7) and the
  manual-inspection artifact. Two script runs produce byte-identical trees
  (`diff -r` clean).

The shipped mainnet anchor config lives at
`docs/recovery/recovery-anchor.mainnet.json` (pinned against the compiled
constants by `cmd/harmony-recovery.TestAnchorDriftPin`).
